rows.note: Use 好睇 as the all-purpose choice for an entertaining film, show, event, or story.

example.english: This film is really entertaining; everyone laughed from start to finish.
example.traditional: 呢套電影真係好睇，成班人由頭笑到尾。
example.jyutping: ne1 tou3 din6 jing2 zan1 hai6 hou2 tai2 sing4 baan1 jan4 jau4 tau4 siu3 dou3 mei5

rows.note: Use 好玩 when the entertaining thing is an activity, game, or experience that is fun to take part in.

example.english: This board game is entertaining, and we did not want to stop playing all night.
example.traditional: 呢個桌遊好玩，我哋玩咗成晚都唔捨得停。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zoek3 jau4 hou2 waan2 ngo5 dei6 waan2 zo2 seng4 maan5 dou1 m4 se2 dak1 ting4

rows.note: Use 搞笑 when entertaining mainly means funny or likely to make people laugh.

example.english: The story he told was really entertaining and made us laugh until our stomachs hurt.
example.traditional: 佢講嗰個故仔真係搞笑，搞到我哋笑到肚痛。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 go2 go3 gu2 zai2 zan1 hai6 gaau2 siu3 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 dei6 siu3 dou3 tou5 tung3
